serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I need to ask Annalie about the island…
How should I start the conversation? 
“Hi, how do you know all that stuff? Are you hiding something from me”?!
@Or maybe be: “Spill the beans, will ya?!
…
I should’ve thought about it before I left the flat… Now I’m gonna do circles around her shop, thinking about how to start that conversation…
I will think something out. Freestyle isn’t my strong side, but being awkward is better than freezing out here.
